name: computer_core_2
title: Computer Core 2 (ALPHA)
author: SirEdvin; original Computer Core by Relik77 and contributors
description: EXPERIMENTAL ALPHA PLAYTEST - terminal-only Lua OS with pinned Recrafted shell/editors, local files and durable guest execution. Breaking replacement of the 0.1.x workbench/callback APIs; old files/drafts are retained but programs are not converted. No guest world, circuit, wireless, speaker or HTTP APIs. Client rendering/input and multiplayer acceptance remain unverified. Use a fresh world or backed-up save copy; never downgrade a migrated save. Expect bugs, slow boot/editor response and API changes.
